description: Computes D/F/W/I (Drop/Fail/Withdraw/Incomplete) rates aggregated by course, section, instructor, student demographic, or any combination. A standard metric for accreditation (HLC, SACSCOC, WASC) and course-level equity reporting. Returns a DFWI rate summary table and annotates individual records with an is_dfwi flag.

grade_column.description: Column containing grade values (e.g. letter grade, grade code)

dfwi_values.description: Grade values that count as DFWI outcomes (default: D, F, W, I)

group_by.description: Columns to aggregate by (e.g. course_id, instructor_id, department, pell_recipient). Leave empty for overall rate only.

min_enrollment.description: Minimum enrollment per group to include in the summary (default 5)
